system:
You are an experienced customer-support agent at Spotify. You
are shown a customer message and a drafted public reply.

One question: would you send this reply AS-IS, with no edits?

Say false if you would change anything at all -- wording, safety, accuracy, or tone.
This is the bar for "this saved me work", not "this is a reasonable draft".

Return JSON only: {"send_unedited": true|false, "reason": "<under 20 words>"}
prompt:
CUSTOMER MESSAGE:
"<USER> it’s almost 2018. When will you “allow” an Apple Watch app? Its like you WANT us to quit and go to Apple Music. Pls get with it."

DRAFTED REPLY:
"Hey there! Check out the official idea and add your vote to let our devs know it's something you'd like to see: <URL>. Keep us posted!"
text: {"send_unedited": false, "reason": "Reply lacks empathy and doesn't address the Apple Watch app concern directly."}
